text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having caught word of someone looking to employ their services,
{0} and Djeeta make their way to the business district to find them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータと{0}はある日、
騎空団に仕事を頼みたい人がいるという話を耳にし、
繁華街へ向かった。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hello! 
We heard that you've got potential work for us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちはー！
仕事の依頼があるって聞いてきたんですけどー……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So you're the much rumored skyfarers, huh? Thanks for
coming. Truth is, this store's been getting all sorts of harassment
from Krook'd & Co. I need you to fend them off once and for all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
君たちが騎空団か！
よく来てくれた！　
君たちにはこの店を、
アクドーイ商会の嫌がらせから、
守って欲しいんだ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Krook'd & Co., huh...
I've heard the rumors about them expanding their,
uh, business. And how they go about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アクドーイ商会……
最近ランドソルで色々な事業に手を広げはじめた、
っていう……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And now they're trying to take this store and rights to
the land from me! On a daily basis, no less. 
It's killing my business, I tell you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤツらはこの店と、
土地を俺から奪い取ろうとしてるんだ！
それで毎日嫌がらせを……
おかげで商売あがったりさ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
That's awful...
Okay, don't worry. We'll sort them out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひどい……
分かりました。
私たちに任せてください！

text_block_list.text:
Well, well. If it isn't the person hogging up my favorite spot
in town. Will today be the day you finally give in, perhaps?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おやおや、
どうしたんですか？
今日こそ、
ここを明け渡していただけますよね？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Who're you?!

text_block_list.name: Krook'd
text_block_list.text:
Call me Krook'd, my dear. Of Krook'd & Co.
Pardon me, but who might you be? Friends of his, possibly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はアクドーイ。
アクドーイ商会のアクドーイと申します。
失礼ですがあなたは……？　
そちらの方のお知り合いですか？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I'm Djeeta.
It's me and my crewmate here's job
to keep this store out of nefarious hands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はジータ。
この人のお店を守る依頼を受けた騎空団です！

text_block_list.name: Krook'd
text_block_list.text:
Oh ho? Hired yourself a crew, I see.
Lovely. You and I share similar mindsets.
It's your time to shine, my friends!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎空団……
そうですか、
そちらも手を打ってきたと……
我々、
考えることはとても似ているようですね。
みなさん、
出番ですよ！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey hey! Lemme give you a fair warning, my dude.
Your ass is in for a bruising if you don't pack up shop right now.
Those two shrimps ain't gonna change that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
店主さんよぉ！
大人しく立ち退かないと……
とんでもないことになるぜ？
そこのガキ二人なんかに、
俺らの相手は出来っこねぇぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Eek! H-help!
Krook'd hired that guild to force me out of here!
Do something about them! I'm begging you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひぃ……！
　た、助けてくれ！
こいつら、アクドーイに店の立ち退きを頼まれてるギルドだ。
お願いだ、追い払ってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Okay. You stay back!
We'll handle this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
店長さんは下がってください！
ここは私たちが！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but this ends today.
If you want someone to take on, we'll gladly accept!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ以上、
勝手なことはさせません！
私たちが相手になります！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
You got guts, kid!
We ain't gonna hold back, though!
Go earn your keep, boys!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい度胸じゃねぇか！
こっちも仕事だ！　
容赦しねぇから覚悟しろ！
お前ら、
やっちまえ！

text_block_list.name: Subordinates
text_block_list.text: Woooooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: うおおおおおおっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Here they come! Brace yourself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来るよ！　
構えて！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1
text_block_list.text: Hiyahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: おりゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: You're wide open! Hahh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこだっ！　
たあっ！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1
text_block_list.text: Graagh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐおあっ！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
Quit playin' around, you losers!
They're just kids! Pile on 'em!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガキ二人に何やってんだバカ野郎！
遊びじゃねぇんだぞ！　
もっとガンガン行け！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Be careful! We're outnumbered by a fair bit!
text_block_list.orig_text: 相手のギルドは大勢だから気をつけて！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I will, thanks!
We don't want the store getting damaged,
so let's lead them away from it bit by bit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
ありがとう！
戦ってお店を壊されないように、
少しずつここから離れよう！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text: Drop dead, kid!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おらっ！　
いい加減くたばっちまえよっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Urgh! No thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ……！　
　
このおっ！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text: Gragh!
text_block_list.orig_text: がはっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff* You okay...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、はぁ……
大丈夫……？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Good to hear.
Keep it up. We're almost done...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
良かった……
もう少しだけ、
付き合って……！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
The hell do I keep you lot around for?
Guess I'll need to sort this mess out myself.
Hey, you! Forget these losers. Let's have a nice, fair duel!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガキ二人にいつまで手こずってやがる！
こうなったら俺がケリをつけてやるよ……
おい、テメェ！　
俺と一対一で決闘といこうじゃねぇか！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: A duel...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 決闘……？

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
You heard me. We'll keep our hands off this place if you win.
If you lose, though, then it's ours. Plus you've gotta disband
that crew of yours. Sound good, Mr. Krook'd?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああそうだ。
テメェが勝ったら店には二度と手を出さねぇ。
だが負けた時は、
店を渡してテメェら騎空団も解散してもらう！
アクドーイさんよ、
別に構わねぇだろぉ？

text_block_list.name: Krook'd
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I trust your judgment.
Do spare me the shame of you losing, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
どうぞご自由に。
ただし、
万が一にも負けるのだけは勘弁してくださいね。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Don't accept it! They'd never fight fair.
He's obviously got something up his sleeve!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなむちゃくちゃな決闘、
受けちゃダメだ！
何か仕掛けがあるに決まってる！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Okay. I accept.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わかりました。
その決闘、受けます。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Why?!
text_block_list.orig_text: どうして……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
We don't have a choice. It's either this, or lose the numbers game.
They've obviously got something planned, but don't worry.
This is as much of a chance for us as it is for them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままだと、
いつかは人数の差で押し切られます……
何かあるかも知れないのは、
私も分かってます。
でもこれは、
私たちにとってチャンスでもあるんです……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
The odds may be low, but they're worth betting on.
I guarantee it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
例えそれが、
どんなに少ない勝ち目でも、
取りにいかなくちゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Got a good head on your shoulders there, squirt.
Get over here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！　
少しは勝負ってもんを理解してるじゃねぇか。
前に出てこい！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Wish me luck.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……行ってくるね。

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep it simple. The duel starts when this coin hits the floor.
You okay with that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
このコインが地に落ちた音を合図に、
決闘開始だ。
いいな？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: I am.
text_block_list.orig_text: 分かった。

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: Cool. 'Cause I ain't!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあいくぜ……
なんてなぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Wahh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: He threw the coin at me!
text_block_list.orig_text: コインで不意打ちを……！？

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: Down you go!
text_block_list.orig_text: もらったぁ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Urgh!
text_block_list.orig_text: あぐっ！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on! Throw that towel in, baby!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おらおらおらぁ！　
とっとと降参しちまいなぁ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I-I'm not throwing anything in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぐっ、
ま、
まだまだっ……！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
You damn poser! I know you're just a skyfarer in name!
You ain't even got an airship to speak of! It's pathetic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何が騎空団だ！　
空なんて飛べもしねぇくせに！
調子に乗るんじゃねぇ！　
大人しく地べたを這いつくばってろ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
No it's not! We don't have one yet, but that'll change!
One day we'll take to the skies!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこと、
ない……！　
いつか必ず、
私たちは飛んでみせる！
この空をっ！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: Like hell you will!
text_block_list.orig_text: 甘いなっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ahh! My sword—!
text_block_list.orig_text: あっ！　剣が──！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: You're done for!
text_block_list.orig_text: コイツで終わりだ！！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Is this it? Is this all I'm capable of?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが私の限界……？　
これで終わりなのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Sorry...
I can't keep that promise we made anymore...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね……
一緒に空を飛ぶ約束、
叶えられなくなっちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right!
There's still so much left for us to do.
I can't give up here... I'd be a fool to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよね……
あなたの言う通りだよ……！
諦めちゃだめだ……！
だって私たちにはまだ、
やるべきことがあるんだから……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
This duel isn't over!
Not by a long shot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ終わってない……！
勝負は──！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: The hell?! You trying to blind me now?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
眩しっ……
目くらましか！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: We're just getting started!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──勝負はここからだよ！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where'd that outfit come from?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コイツ、
いつの間に着替えやがった……！？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, {0}.
I was ready to give in, but your voice gave me the will to go on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞こえたヨ、
あなたの声……
倒れそうだった私を、
支えてくれた……！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: Whatever. You're still going down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいい、
これで終わりだっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Think again, buddy! Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見切った！　
破ァッ！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text:
What the?! How'd she manage to counter that?!
I dunno what happened, but she got real fast all of a sudden!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何ぃ！？　
今ので反撃をくらうわけがねぇ……！
なんだアイツの拳は……
早すぎる！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
And now for the finishing blow!
Eat this! Flashpoint! Haahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一気に畳みかけるよ！
奥義……「絶閃」！　
はあぁぁぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Guild Master
text_block_list.text: Graagh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐあああぁぁぁぁっ！！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1＆Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text: B-Boss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た……
大将ぉぉぉっ！！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
This duel's as good as over.
But hey. If you wanna keep going, then I'll take you down again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁぁぁ……
……決着はついたよ。
まだ続けるか？
　やるっていうなら
相手になるよ？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
If not,
then take him and get lost. For good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
終わりにするなら、
そこで倒れてる男と一緒に、
早くどっか行きな！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1＆Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text: Eeek! Come on, Boss! Get a grip!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひぃぃぃぃ！　
しっかりしてくれ大将、
大将ぉ！

text_block_list.name: Krook'd
text_block_list.text: Now you've done it. Trust me, I'll remember this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やってくれましたね。
覚えておきなさい！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Phew... Now that was a hairy situa—
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふぅ。
危ないとこだったね──

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? W-what just happened there?
Oh... Krook'd and that guild disappeared, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──あれ……？　
私、
何を……？
そうだ、
あの人、
たちは……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Thanks.
I... I won, didn't I? I remember being close to passing out,
but everything after that is a blur...
choice_data_list: Your clothes and speech changed out of nowhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
ありがとう。
……私、
勝ったんだよね……？
倒れそうになった後、
何をしたのかよく覚えてなくて……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Even my speech? Honestly,
I was so desperate that I didn't even notice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
話しかたも……？　
必死だったから気づかなかったけど、
私、
そんなことになってたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now it's starting to come back to me.
What in the world was with that power?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょっとずつだけど、
思い出してきた。
何がどうなってるのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but one thing's for sure.
We'd be able to do a lot more if I mastered it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの力を使いこなせるようになればきっと、
もっとたくさんのことが出来るようになるよね？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
That said, I don't even know how I triggered it in the first place.
If I had to guess, I'd say it had something to do with you.
Which reminds me. Thanks for calling out to me—it was a big help!
choice_data_list: Travelling the world might bring us the answer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
ほんとにどうやったんだろう……？
ひょっとしたら、
あなたが声をかけてくれたおかげかも。
あの時はありがとう。
すっごく心強かった！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Maybe. Actually, no. I'm sure it will!
We're still a ways off from getting an airship,
but now we have another goal for when we do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうかも知れない……
ううん、
きっとそうだよ！
いつか一緒に空の旅に出て、
答えを探してみよう！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Djeeta?!
Thank you so, so much!
I honestly don't know how to repay you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータさん、
大丈夫ですか！？
今回は本当にありがとうございました！
なんとお礼を言えばいいのか……！　
本当にありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
You really don't need to. 
If anything, I should apologize for coming so close to losing.
Still though, I'm glad I was able to help in the end!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな……
決闘で負けそうになっちゃって、
すみませんでした。
でも、
勝ってお店を守ることが出来て、
良かったです！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
It was a close call, but we managed to pull through.
The more time I spend with you, the more confident I get
that we'll be able to set to the skies someday.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日みたいなピンチが乗り越えられたんだ……
あなたと一緒なら、
空を旅出来るようになる日も
そんなに遠くない気がする……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
A smile upon her face, Djeeta set her sights on the
bright future her newfound power could lead her to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータは微笑みながら、自らの中に眠っていた力の可能性と
これからの日々に思いを馳せた。
